RESOLUTION IS AN UPGRADE, NOT PARITY. The file it replaces is 1024x1024, which caps the theme's generated srcset at 1000w; this block's box is 660 CSS px at a 1440 viewport, so a 2x screen wanted ~1320px and was being served an upscale. At 2048 the srcset reaches 2000w and the block is sharp at 2x.

LABEL VERIFIED BY COUNTING ELEMENTS, NOT BY SPELLCHECKING — a label missing an element passes a check that only reads the lines present. All six are there and correct: the dotted double-helix brand mark, the 'Skingenetix' wordmark, 'COPPER PEPTIDE', 'ADVANCED NIGHT REPAIR' in blue, 'PREMIUM FORMULA', and the crescent-moon glyph followed by 'NIGHT CREAM | 2% GHK-CU | 50ML'. Two things specifically checked because they have been wrong before: GHK-CU is spelled correctly here (the ChatGPT-sourced artwork carried GHD-CU), and 50ML is right for the cream. Checked at full size, because a contact sheet cannot judge lettering.

⚠️ NOTE FOR MALCOLM, not a fault in this file: this is the pale-blue-on-bright-marble night cream. It is the known Day-is-dark / Night-is-light inversion already recorded against the product artwork — the night product reads lighter than the day product. Nothing to fix in this shot; flagged only because this block is the one place on the page where the night cream is shown.

WHAT IT REPLACES. skingenetix-copper-peptide-night-cream-bottle.jpg, 1024x1024. It stays in Files and simply stops being referenced — nothing is renamed or overwritten, because Langify keys translations off the URL.

MASTER IS SQUARE, which media-with-text requires: the row height is max(text column, image natural height) and .media-with-text__media carries no aspect-ratio of its own, so a non-square master stretches its row and the block stops matching its five siblings. This block is the tallest of the six by text — measured at 0.819 at 1440 and 0.599 at 1024 — so it takes the deepest side-crop on the page. The subject survives it: the jar and the full label sit centre-left with the lid and swatch filling the right, and the crop takes marble and backdrop.

WEB LOADING. Converted from the 5220K PNG to JPEG q95 4:4:4 progressive with metadata dropped, 893K — the documented policy in .claude/rules/website-imagery.md rule 5: quality 95 and 4:4:4 so the CDN's WebP pass gets a clean picture to encode from, rather than a low-quality JPEG whose artefacts cost bits to reproduce. Not re-encoded below that; compressing the source was measured on 2026-08-24 and made the site marginally slower. Long edge 2048, inside the 3000px cap and above the 2000w top of this block's srcset. Delivered bytes verified off the CDN after upload, because the CDN is what a visitor downloads.

SEO FILENAME built from the page and the block: brand, 'copper peptide' and 'ghk cu' and 'night cream' from the block title 'Copper Peptide (GHK-Cu) Night Cream - Overnight Structural Repair', and 'open jar swatch' for what is in frame. 65 characters. Checked against Shopify Files first and the name is free — a collision is silently suffixed and the OLD image keeps serving while every log says success.
